title: cheilanthes tenuifolia var. tenuissima
intro: Cheilanthes tenuifolia var. tenuissima, commonly known as a type of fern, is a plant species that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. This plant is used to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties, which help to relieve coughs and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Cheilanthes tenuifolia var. tenuissima include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant also include its ability to reduce fever, soothe digestive issues, and promote wound healing.
